items.title: Seagate Went From $207 to $1,144. Where Does It Go Next?
items.summary: Seagate just delivered a run that defied every expectation for a hardware stock, and Wall Street is still raising its numbers at a furious pace. Whether the next move is a collapse or another leg up depends on one tension hiding inside the bull case.

items.title: Micron Fell For 3 Months: Now One Wall Street Pro Says 110% Are About to Materialize
items.summary: Micron slid for three months while the S&P 500 climbed, reopening a price-to-target gap that one prominent analyst now believes is far larger than the Street consensus suggests. Whether that gap represents a generational opportunity or a familiar cycle trap depends entirely on a single question about memory.

items.title: Can Sovereign AI and Neoclouds Extend Western Digital's Growth Run?
items.summary: WDC sees sovereign customers, neoclouds and physical AI broadening HDD demand, with tighter supply creating added pricing leverage.

items.title: SanDisk Stock Jumped 11% on S&P 100 News. Here’s What the Street Says.
items.summary: Key TakeawaysIndex Bid: SanDisk stock jumped 11% on Thursday after joining the S&P 100. Street Split: TIKR tracks 25 analysts on SanDisk stock, splitting 16 buys, 4 outperforms, 3 holds, 1 underperform and 1 sell, while the $2,125 mean target sits 19% above Thursday’s $1,792 close.

items.title: Up 500% In 12 Months, This is Where Micron Is Headed
items.summary: Micron just delivered the most jaw-dropping quarter any US semiconductor company has posted this cycle, yet the stock is sliding and analysts are at war over what comes next. Where the smart money lands may surprise you.

items.title: Prediction: Seagate Could Be a Surprisingly Big Winner From the AI Boom
items.summary: Hard drives look like a relic next to the glamorous AI chip trade, yet Seagate shareholders have watched the stock surge nearly 300% in a single year. The real question is whether the forces driving that run have staying power or whether the easy money is already gone.

items.title: SanDisk Stock Looks Cheap, But Can It Keep Earning This Much?
items.summary: SanDisk (SNDK) has returned nearly 1,600% over the past twelve months and still trades at 19.5 times earnings, against an S&P 500 median of 22.4. It sits about 35% below its 52-week high. A cash-generative business priced under the market is where value buyers start. The question is whether those earnings are a new normal or the top of a memory cycle.

items.title: Seagate’s Gross Margin Hit 52.7% Last Quarter. Here’s Why the CFO Says It Holds
items.summary: Key Stats for Seagate StockCurrent Price: $771. 81Target Price (Mid): ~$3,200Street Target: ~$1,125Potential Total Return: ~315%Annualized IRR: ~35% / yearWhat Happened?Seagate Technology Holdings (STX) has done something the market spent a decade assuming a hard-drive maker could never do: raise prices, quarter after quarter, and make it stick.
